propositions: Replace fuzzy ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes with closed Literal kind sets to enable deterministic gate behavior, eliminating LLM classification unreliability.

Both axes currently map all non-none grades to hard-override floor of 0.85 via _PLAN_HARD_OVERRIDE_FLOOR, making ordinal distinctions inert; undecomposed has zero firing G5 suppressors and dod_uncertifiable conflates three distinct defects under one floor.
Undecomposed conversion defines six kinds: none, bundles_separable_slices (advisory, 0.55), missing_required_child (floor, 0.85), and no_executable_breakdown (floor, 0.85).
Dod_uncertifiable conversion defines six kinds: none, underspecified_certification (advisory, 0.55), uncertifiable_outcome (floor, 0.85), and certification_cannot_prove (floor, 0.85).
Land sidecar per-finding priority-margin telemetry (priority - block_threshold) and bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION from plan-v4 to plan-v5 as a single unit per ADR 0054 section 4.

Zero-LLM re-score of 22,667 corpus findings against pinned plan-v4 baseline shows pessimistic 47 lost / 35 gained and optimistic 15 lost / 64 gained; hand audit of all 15 losses confirms none are unjustified (all are bundling or specificity complaints, no genuine-gap outcomes omitted).
